acquisition method: a full Orbitrap MS scan detected tandem MS (MS/MS) spectra of the ten most intense precursors
alkylation reagent: followed by 20 min alkylation with 1 μL of 550 mM iodoacetamide in the dark
alkylation concentration: followed by 20 min alkylation with 1 μL of 550 mM iodoacetamide in the dark
cleavage agent: Proteins were digested at room temperature for 3 h with lysyl endopeptidase (Wako) at a protease/protein ratio of 1:100, thereupon urea was diluted to 2 M with 50 mM ammonium bicarbonate and digestion continued with sequencing grade trypsin (Promega) for 12 h at room temperature at a protease/protein ratio of 1:100
collision energy: The relative collision energy for rapid collision-induced dissociation (rCID) was set to 35%
fragmentation method: The relative collision energy for rapid collision-induced dissociation (rCID) was set to 35%
instrument: analyzed with an EASY-nLC 1000 liquid chromatography (LC) system (Thermo Scientific) and a Q-Exactive HF mass spectrometer (Thermo Scientific)... coupled to an LTQ Orbitrap Elite mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific Inc., Waltham, MA, USA)
labeling: MaxQuant 1.5.3.175 label-free protein quantifications (LFQ) algorithm used for quantification
reduction reagent: Cysteines reduction was achieved by 30 min incubation at room temperature with 1 μL of 1 M dithiothreitol
reduction concentration: Cysteines reduction was achieved by 30 min incubation at room temperature with 1 μL of 1 M dithiothreitol
